source.author: lucan
source.text: Dumque illi effusam longis anfractibus urbem Circueunt, Aruns dispersos fulminis ignes Colligit, et terrae moesto cum murmure condit, Datque locis nomen sacris.
source.text_original: Dumque illi effusam longis anfractibus urbem / Circueunt, Aruns dispersos fulminis ignes / Colligit, et terrae moesto cum murmure condit, / Datque locis nomen sacris.
source.text_english: And while they circled the city spread out in long windings, Aruns gathered up the scattered fires of the thunderbolt and buried them in the earth with a mournful murmur, and gave the sacred places a name.
